mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are enjoying clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 76 degrees. Tonight, the moon phase is a New Moon, and we have a special treat as the International Space Station will be visible starting at 8:19 PM, rising in the Southwest over Mount Horeb and traveling toward the East Northeast, passing almost directly overhead.

In city news, the City of Verona has published several election notices for the upcoming November general election. Additionally, construction is underway on the Military Ridge State Trail bridge between Lincoln and South Franklin Street, which will remain closed through mid-November with marked detours for pedestrians and cyclists.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today, you can join a class at Yoga at Insight Wellness or enjoy trivia at Hop Haus. Tomorrow, catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, don't miss the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival in town on September 13.

In a noteworthy update, the Verona Police Department announced an arrest on September 4 regarding an incident from Sunday, August 30, involving a school staff member accused of sexual assault of a child.
Today's flavor at Culver's is the rich Dark Chocolate Decadence. The restaurant is currently open until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to head over and enjoy a scoop.
